svg.title: Copy on write publication and cleanup gates
svg.desc: Reserve a private candidate, protect the source, copy and append without publishing. Required completion and matching active branch version precede one protected mapping length and ownership commit. Precommit active branch failure preserves old prefix; submitted work still needs safe cleanup. Postcommit failure retires the committed state.
svg.text: A candidate stays unpublished until commit
One lifecycle authority; matching branch version; no conflicting writer
Old A/B tables and valid lengths stay authoritative.
Candidate is ready; still reject if A cancelled or its version changed.
A receives candidate authority; old A source edge releases once.
Failure before commit preserves an active branch’s old prefix.
Submitted source/destination uses still wait for safe completion.
After commit, retire the new authoritative state; do not revive the old table.
